$comment: Generated by `largen manifest` from sites/example/components.css. Pass this to the largen MCP server so its tools answer in terms of this project's components rather than largen's reference set.

tone.description: Semantic colour. Inherits — set it on a container to re-tone everything inside.

variant.description: How the tone is applied as a fill. Derived from the tone, never a separate colour. Applies to the element it is on.

size.description: One multiplier scaling type, padding and gap. Inherits.

notes: State (disabled, invalid, checked, read-only) is NOT settable here. It comes from the DOM and from real HTML attributes.
There is no field for a colour, a class, or inline CSS. The safety property is structural, not defensive: the worst a compromised model can do is pick the wrong approved component.

components.name: catalog-header
components.for: The masthead: title on the left, navigation on the right.

components.name: catalog-title
components.for: The name of the catalogue, linking to its index.

components.name: entry-item
components.for: An entry in the catalogue. One shell for every kind of entry.

components.name: entry-link
components.for: A link in the catalogue: muted until hovered or current.

components.name: entry-meta
components.for: An entry's metadata row — author, date, counts.

components.name: facet
components.for: A filter chip. Tone carries whether it is active.

components.name: facet-label
components.for: The label above a group of filter chips.

components.name: field-name
components.for: The name half of a field row.

components.name: field-row
components.for: A name/value row, for an entry's structured detail.

components.name: field-value
components.for: The value half of a field row.

components.name: note
components.for: A callout box. Set data-type to choose its tone.

components.name: note-title
components.for: The heading line of a note.

components.name: timeline
components.for: A vertical run of dated entries against a rule.

components.name: timeline-entry
components.for: One dated entry on the timeline.

components.name: timeline-when
components.for: The date on a timeline entry.
